name: Tapo C120 (EU)

matter.note: The Spanish product page doesn't mention Matter and we found no CSA listing.

apple_home.note: The Spanish product page doesn't mention Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: The page lists Google Home and Google Assistant; what works beyond live view is not detailed.

alexa.note: The page lists Amazon Alexa; what works beyond live view is not detailed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link Smart Home integration lists the C120. Live view needs a camera account created in the Tapo app.

hubRequired.note: A Wi-Fi camera with its own power adapter; the page mentions no hub.

localControl.note: Home Assistant connects over the local network, but Tapo doesn't state that app control works without the cloud. ONVIF/RTSP isn't described on the product page.

cameraType.note: Tapo sells it for indoor and outdoor use, rated IP66; recorded as outdoor because that is its more capable fit.

power.note: 5 V DC, 1.0 A adapter with a 3 m cable.

localStorage.note: microSD slot, up to 512 GB (card sold separately).

subscription.value: Optional Tapo Care plan for cloud video history
subscription.note: Tapo Care adds a 30-day cloud clip history; the first month is a free trial. EU prices not checked.

summary: On a Tapo C120, Alexa and Google Home are the listed ecosystems, and Home Assistant supports it through the TP-Link integration. Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter aren't mentioned. It's a plug-in 2K Wi-Fi camera rated IP66 for indoor or outdoor use. A microSD card up to 512 GB records locally, and the optional Tapo Care plan adds 30-day cloud history.
caveats: It needs mains power through the 3 m adapter cable, so the spot must have an outlet.
Home Assistant live view needs a camera account set in the Tapo app.
Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter aren't mentioned on Tapo's page.
